label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall. Freight, innkeeper and builder coordinated replacement of spoiled bread with 200 fresh loaves, eight lanterns, baking and deliveries. Baker knowingly donated 132 wheat and free oven use; neighbour delivered bread and arranged to escort the mayor without revealing the surprise. The record shows no disclosure of the jubilee to the mayor and no knowing assistance by the secretary.
